questions.answer: I had to show up in person several times, since some of the courses were declined from the receiving institution.

questions.answer: The university itself.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *

questions.answer: Call/write them before.

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: At the math faculty, the level was high, but at the Economics faculty, I suppose it is higher at my home university.

questions.answer: Same

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer: Graphs, Econometrics I, Game Theory and Application in Economics, Mathematical Models and Dynamical Systems, Preliminary German, History of Economic Thought, Financial Mathematics

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Maybe the ones taught in English at the Economic faculty, since the local students tend to be on their own.
